rounds.text: This fundamental strength is underscored by a rules-based screen score of 85 out of 100 yielding a high-confidence buy [E58], supported by a discounted cash flow intrinsic value calculation pointing to a 50.9% margin of safety [E40]. Operating margins are expanding robustly, reaching 34% in Mar 2026—an 11 percentage point increase over three years—alongside ₹ 21 Cr in free cash flow and a pristine balance sheet featuring a debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.02x [E24, E30, E32]. Furthermore, technical momentum confirms the setup as the price trades comfortably above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E44]. Conceded: [E15], [E16], [E36], [E37], [E46], [E47].

Conceded: [E24], [E30], [E32], [E40], [E44], [E58]. While the bull highlights the rules-based screen score and intrinsic value calculations, it ignores severe top-line stagnation where compounded sales growth over 3 years is a meager 2% and trailing twelve month sales growth crawls at just 1% [E15, E16]. The claim of technical momentum and safety ignores that the 12-month price return sits at -17.1% alongside a painful historical drawdown of -56.0% and a poor Sharpe ratio of 0.20 [E46, E47, E49]. Furthermore, institutional confidence is actively fleeing the counter, evidenced by foreign and domestic institutional holdings dropping significantly and negative money flows flashing alongside the scanX signal engine's specific warning of institutional outflow [E36, E37, E38, E63]. Finally, the bull's reliance on expanding operating margins and balance sheet pristine status glosses over rising structural headwinds, including a price-to-book ratio of 4.84x that heavily outpaces the sector benchmark of 1.87x and an EV/EBITDA of 13.47x trading above its sector median [E7, E11, E24, E32].
